Name: Hold To Attack
Author: MGLXI
Description:
[color=#00ffff][size=5][font=Arial Black]Hold To Attack[/font][/size][/color]

Tired of mashing your mouse button every time you want to swing your sword?

Hold To Attack lets you attack continuously by simply holding down the attack button with any melee weapon (swords, daggers, clubs, and hammers). Release the button and the attacks stop.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

[color=#00ffff][size=5][font=Arial Black]✔ FEATURES[/font][/size][/color]

• Works with all melee weapons (swords, daggers, clubs, hammers)
• Respects each weapon's own speed and cooldown
• Compatible with custom weapon mods
• Works with keyboard/mouse and controller
• Lightweight and no configuration needed

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

[color=#00ffff][size=5][font=Arial Black]🎮 CONTROLS[/font][/size][/color]

• Hold Left Mouse Button → continuous melee attacks
• Or hold the attack button on your controller (A / X)

Release the button and the attacks stop immediately.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

[color=#00ffff][size=5][font=Arial Black]📦 REQUIREMENTS[/font][/size][/color]

• Stardew Valley 1.6+
• SMAPI 4.0.0 or newer

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

[color=#00ffff][size=5][font=Arial Black]🛠️ INSTALLATION[/font][/size][/color]

1. Install SMAPI first (https://smapi.io).
2. Download the latest version of Hold To Attack.
3. Extract the .zip file.
4. Copy the "HoldToAttack" folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder:
  • Windows: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods
  • macOS: ~/Library/Application Support/Steam/steamapps/common/Stardew Valley/Mods
  • Linux: ~/.steam/steam/steamapps/common/Stardew Valley/Mods
5. Launch the game through SMAPI.

You should see "[HoldToAttack] HoldToAttack loaded successfully" in the SMAPI console.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

[color=#00ffff][size=5][font=Arial Black]🗑️ UNINSTALLATION[/font][/size][/color]

1. Close Stardew Valley.
2. Delete the "HoldToAttack" folder from your Mods folder.
3. Launch the game. Your save files are not affected.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

[color=#00ffff][size=5][font=Arial Black]🔗 COMPATIBILITY[/font][/size][/color]

• Compatible with most mods that add custom melee weapons.
• Not tested in multiplayer. Use at your own risk.
• Should not conflict with combat overhauls, but if you find an issue, report it.
